-- DROP EXTERNAL TABLE revenue_ext_table
CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE revenue_ext_table(
    Dealer_ID VARCHAR(20),
    Model_ID VARCHAR(20),
    Branch_ID VARCHAR(20),
    Date_ID VARCHAR(20),
    Units_Sold BIGINT,
    Revenue BIGINT
)
WITH(
    LOCATION = 'revenue',
    DATA_SOURCE = raw_ext_source,
    FILE_FORMAT = csv_format
)

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM revenue_ext_table; --1857
SELECT * FROM revenue_ext_table;
